blends.name: Palagon Trophy Pack
blends.desc:
# Palagon Trophy Pack The Palagon Trophy Pack is the ultimate prize for those that successfully assembled the complete 15-part collaborative story between [HodlGod](http://hodlgod.com) and [Dr. Zammsy](http://drzammsy.com/). Once collected, each 15-part story set can be fused (*burned*) to claim a trophy pack containing 4 beautiful and distinct trophies. There are 11 distinct mint-on-demand trophy NFTs to collect. Which ones will you get? Each Palagon Trophy Pack contains **4** random trophy NFTs out of a set of ***11*** in *total*. Trophy NFTs are minted in four variations: ***Trophy**, **Sealed**, **Awakened**,* and ***Bounty***. **Unbox your trophies on either [NeftyBlocks](https://neftyblocks.com/c/hodlgod/packs) or [AtomicHub](https://wax.atomichub.io/unbox/5893)!** Each pack contains: * 1 Palagon Trophy * 1 of 3 Sealed Runes * 1 of 3 Awakened Runes * 1 of 4 Bounty Trophies * *0.75% chance of getting a bonus trophy pack*!
Note: *These assets are intended as collaborative collectibles, and are not directly a part of any game*.

blends.name: Solid Aurum Immortal Gear
blends.desc:
Be ready to grab exclusive in-game loot with this Series 2 Immortal Gear set. Forge your set today to be ready for the next game update so you can be among the first to wear this one-of-a-kind skin.

To [forge](https://hodlgod.com/badges) a Solid Aurum Series 2 Immortal Gear set you must combine all 4 the requisite shards:
* [Solid Aurum Mainhand Weapon Shard](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=hodlgod&order=asc&schema_name=series.2&sort=price&symbol=WAX&template_id=389432) * [Solid Aurum Armour Shard](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=hodlgod&order=asc&schema_name=series.2&sort=price&symbol=WAX&template_id=389431) * [Solid Aurum Offhand Weapon Shard](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=hodlgod&order=asc&schema_name=series.2&sort=price&symbol=WAX&template_id=389433) * [Solid Aurum Bow Shard](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=hodlgod&order=asc&schema_name=series.2&sort=price&symbol=WAX&template_id=389434) **combined shards will be burned after forging.*

Immortal Shards can be found inside HodlGod Immortal Gear - Series 2 Packs, which are [on sale now](https://neftyblocks.com/c/hodlgod/drops/78453)! Get yours today!
